test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If in a coding system, SHELVES is coded as 100 and TURNING is coded as 87, then how will REDRESS be coded in the same coding system?
solution:
**The table is alphabets place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Sum of the opposite alphabets place value + 1 = number.**

SHELVES is coded as 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14c0fd51c058fbfd105a746cfdd6777e88bad82af8963dc3c00487db6d84b824.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets place value + 1 = number.

And,

TURNING is coded as 87

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1124ff7b7b9a41cfdc745b8093cc9a4b5c7ba19fdcbc5fb6047cad40912c57a1.png] 

Sum of the opposite alphabets place value + 1 = number.

=> (7 + 6 + 9 + 13 + 18 + 13 + 20) + 1 = 86 + 1 = 87

Similarly,

**REDRESS**** = ?**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd4e467c4e8ca6e3e86f3f493af905a0db772987e17a1c969583cf0b81ddd1fa.png] **

**Sum of the opposite alphabets place value + 1 = number.**

**=> (9 + 22 + 23 + 9 + 22 + 8 + 8) + 1 = 101 + 1 = 102**

Hence, '** REDRESS** ' is coded as **"102".**
